articles.title: Real Madrid makes Lautaro Martinez walk past its European Cups before kickoff
articles.summary: Real Madrid made Lautaro Martinez walk through the same hallway visiting players use before competing at the Santiago Bernabeu.
articles.body:
Real Madrid made Lautaro Martinez walk through the same hallway visiting players use before competing at the Santiago Bernabeu.

Along the way, “El Toro” passed a huge glass display containing the European Cups won by the club. The placement hardly feels accidental: before reaching the field, every visitor receives a reminder of the history waiting for them.

Real Madrid does not need to say a word. Its trophies apply the first bit of pressure and can make any opponent feel 1-0 down before the match even begins.

articles.title: Zidane gets serious as soon as he arrives in France: he puts an end to Mbappé and company’s fashion parade
articles.standfirst: The new French national team coach bans the presence of cameras at the entrances to Clairefontaine to eradicate the extravagant catwalks of his stars
articles.summary: The new French national team coach bans the presence of cameras at the entrances to Clairefontaine to eradicate the extravagant catwalks of his stars
articles.body:
Zinedine Zidane has taken over as head coach of the France national team , imposing his authority from the very first minute . With the aim of restoring internal order and eliminating unnecessary distractions , the legendary former Real Madrid coach has made drastic decisions in the routine of Les Bleus . His arrival marks the beginning of an era characterized by a firm hand and professional rigor.

In recent years, the arrival of the French internationals at the Clairefontaine sports complex had become an extracurricular spectacle that dominated headlines . Players of the caliber of Kylian Mbappé, Jules Koundé, Ibrahima Konaté and Michael Olise used to step out of their vehicles wearing haute couture outfits , extravagant designs and accessories from luxury brands, turning the entrance to the grounds into a true urban fashion runway .

This media tradition, dubbed by the local press as the "blue carpet," used to generate enormous buzz on social media and in the media . However, in the view of the new coaching staff, the public overexposure detracted from the solemnity and diverted attention from what was truly transcendental: performance on the pitch and the tactical preparation for international fixtures .

A media shield to recover the essence

As revealed by the French broadcaster RMC Sport, Zidane's first firm decision has been to ban the access of media outlets and photographers to the main esplanade of Clairefontaine during the players' arrival . By closing the doors to reporters at that precise moment, "Zizou" abruptly removes the incentive for players to show off their extravagant outfits in front of the cameras.

From this call-up onward, the footballers must enter the training camp wearing the official French Football Federation (FFF) kit or understated, coordinated travel clothing. The message from the Gallic governing body to the dressing room is clear: the training center must once again become a sanctuary of professional preparation and not an advertising showcase.

The measure has generated immediate repercussions in the European football environment, where various outlets such as Goal, Mundiario, and Diario Olé have described this move as a true "cultural shift" within the national team structure. Sources linked to the FFF indicate that the strategist seeks to build a sealed-off environment highly focused on tactical discipline .

Hard line and absolute control of the environment

The end of the catwalks is only the tip of the iceberg of the new regime established by Zidane, who seeks to eradicate the privileges and permissive dynamics that had taken hold under the previous management. The coach believes that sporting success requires total immersion from the moment the player walks through the door of the training camp .

According to reports from TNT Sports and Infobae, the new manager will also implement restrictions on the use of mobile devices in common areas , as well as strict schedules for meals and medical recovery sessions. With these regulations, the French coach aims to strengthen group cohesion and reinforce collective authority above individualism .

Analysts at the Sport portal agree that Zidane has the moral backing and unquestionable authority to apply this type of measure without generating friction with the squad's leaders . His status as a French football legend gives him a unique legitimacy to demand the utmost commitment from both young prospects and established stars.

The locker room obeys the mandate of the myth

Squad leaders like Kylian Mbappé have received the new instructions with respect, understanding Zidane's stature within international football . Although players like Jules Koundé had become fashion icons for their eye-catching pre-match "looks," the coaching staff's order is final and will allow no exceptions .

The impact of the decision will be felt strongly on digital platforms, where images of the arrivals at Clairefontaine used to rack up millions of interactions and debates about the latest fashion trends . Nevertheless, those around the federation insist that the absolute priority of this new era must focus exclusively on achieving sporting results.

With this bang on the table, Zinedine Zidane begins his journey with the French national team by showing that discipline is non-negotiable. The era of media spectacle at the gates of the training ground gives way to a period of constructive isolation where only the ball will do the talking.

articles.title: Zidane sparks France revolution: Slams down five roster changes while backing captain Mbappé
articles.standfirst: Eleven players who took part in the last World Cup have been left out of the squad list
articles.summary: Eleven players who took part in the last World Cup have been left out of the squad list
articles.body:
Z inedine Zidane is already acting as the new head coach of France . The French manager will make his debut next October 25 against Turkey at the Yildiz Entegre Kocaeli Stadyumu stadium in Kocaeli and has produced some surprises in his first squad announcement .

One of the big new developments has undoubtedly been the return of Eduardo Camavinga. The midfielder was left out of the squad for the last World Cup at the last minute and, although he has not enjoyed many minutes with Real Madrid at the start of the season, Zidane believes he can contribute a great deal in midfield.

There have also been absences in Zizou 's first call-up. As many as 11 compared to the World Cup squad. On the left side, for example, neither of the Hernández brothers has been called up by the French manager.

Tchouaméni , unlike Camavinga , is ultimately staying in Madrid to recover from the discomfort that has prevented him from competing at the start of the season. Kanté, Digne or Marcus Thuram are other players who have not earned Zidane's trust in his first squad list.

Among the new faces, notable inclusions are Liverpool centre-back Jeremy Jacquet, Rennes forward Esteban Lepaul and Andy Diouf, Da Cunha, midfielder for Como . For rotation in goal, Zidane has decided to call up Toulouse goalkeeper, Guillaume Restes

Zidane will make his debut as France's national team coach on September 25 against Vincenzo Montella's Turkey in the Nations League. After a second away fixture against Mark van Bommel's Belgium, on September 28, Zizou will manage his first home match in charge of Les Bleus o n October 22 against Mancini's revamped Italy.

Goalkeepers: Maignan, Restes, Robin Risser

Defenders: Andy Diouf, Jeremy Jacquet, Pierre Kalulu, Ibrahima Konaté, Jules Koundé, Maxence Lacroix, Adrien Truffert, Dayot Upamecano.

Midfielders: Camavinga, Rayan Cherki, Lucas Da Cunha, Manu Koné, Adrien Rabiot, Warren Zaire-Emery.

Forwards: Bradley Barcola, Ousmane Dembélé, Desiré Doué, Esteban Lepaul, Kylian Mbappé, Michael Olise.

articles.title: Ireland goalkeeper stands firm and will not play against Israel: "Killing innocent people is wrong"
articles.standfirst: "Gavin Bazunu has announced that he refuses to play tomorrow (20:45) in the Nations match
articles.summary: "Gavin Bazunu has announced that he refuses to play tomorrow (20:45) in the Nations match
articles.body:
The Republic of Ireland goalkeeper, Gavin Bazunu , has confirmed in a statement that he will not play in this Sunday's match between his country and Israel, which will be held in Debrecen (Hungary).

In his statement, he expresses this: "Representing my country means everything to me. I have the utmost respect for each of my teammates, for the head coach, for his coaching staff, and for the Irish people. However, I have made a decision that I have not taken lightly. I am a man of strong faith and I try, as far as possible, to be a person of character and principles. T herefore, I believe it would be a mistake to take part in the upcoming matches against Israel. My decision is based exclusively on my personal conviction that killing innocent people is wrong. It is important to point out that my stance is not against the Israeli people or the Jewish community, but against the atrocities being committed in the region. In life, there are few occasions when one has the opportunity to stand up for something more important, and I firmly believe that this is one of them ".

The situation caused Ireland not to carry out the scheduled training session this Saturday at Debrecen's Nagyerdei Stadium. The players remained in meetings for hours with the manager, Heimir Hallgrímsson, and his coaching staff to analyze what decision to make overall. In the end, the Irish team will wear black armbands in solidarity with "all the lives lost in Gaza".

The conflict had been brewing in recent days , even beyond football, with numerous Irish athletes calling for the match not to be held . Inside the dressing room there are differing opinions about the matches against Israel, and some internationals have expressed their discomfort at having to play them.

Bazunu's stance creates a new scenario, as there is now the possibility that other players may decide not to take part. The Football Association of Ireland, for its part, maintains that the matches must be played, after having previously ruled out the option of a boycott.

Ireland will face Israel this Sunday in Debrecen and will play the same opponent again next October 4 in Serbia . The Federation had already warned that canceling the matches could cause significant financial losses and possible sporting consequences.

articles.title: “Olé” chants and a comeback by the World Champion at Wembley
articles.standfirst: Spain held off the English onslaught for an hour and turned the game around thanks to a stellar performance by Alex Baena, who scored and assisted Oyarzabal on the game-winning goal
articles.summary: Spain held off the English onslaught for an hour and turned the game around thanks to a stellar performance by Alex Baena, who scored and assisted Oyarzabal on the game-winning goal
articles.body:
World Cup winner Spain extended its unbeaten run to 39 games by rallying to a 3-2 win against England in the Nations League on Saturday.

Substitute Mikel Oyarzabal came back to haunt England with his 74th-minute winner at Wembley .

Oyarzabal also scored the winning goal when Spain beat England in the final of the European Championship in 2024 . On this occasion he calmly chipped goalkeeper James Trafford from close range to complete the world champion's comeback after trailing 2-1 at halftime.

In Spain's first game since beating Argentina in the World Cup final, its long-running unbeaten streak was put under serious threat by England. It could have been 3-1 down in the second half had Harry Kane not slipped and fired his penalty off the crossbar .

Luis de la Fuente's team responded like champions to make a winning start to its Nations League campaign.

La mine Yamal got Spain off to a flying start, needing less than two minutes to score when he dispossessed England defender Marc Guehi and fired low past Trafford into the far corner.

Spain dominated the chances and the scorer of the winning goal in the World Cup final, Ferran Torres, twice failed to make the most of opportunities when through on goal.

After surviving those scares England leveled through Antony Gordon after a swift breakaway in the 36th.

A quick turnover of possession saw Gordon open Spain up with a smart flick to Jude Bellingham.

Bellingham then sent Gordon through on goal and the Barcelona player slid a low shot past Unai Simon.

England went ahead only four minutes later through Kane, whose header deflected off Marc Cucurella.

Early in the second half England had the chance to extend its lead when Rodri brought down Kane in the box and after VAR referee Davide Massa awarded a penalty . But Spain was let off the hook when Kane slipped during his run.

That miss looked even more costly when on the hour substitute Alex Baena curled a low shot into the corner to level the game again. And Spain completed its comeback as Oyarzabal coolly converted from close range .
